name: Ignis Ultimatus aura can be cancelled (#8003)
contract: #8003: right-clicking Ignis Ultimatus 680369 never removes it. Cause: the aura outlives any channel (1 h duration) while HandleCancelAuraOpcode returned early for every channeled spell without a matching current channel, stranding it; the aura is additionally negative-marked by its intended self-root, which would still block the normal removal path. Fix: the channeled case only returns early when it actually interrupts a matching channel, and both Ignis ranks (680369/280586) clear the negative mark. Cast, wait out the cast time, cancel via the genuine CMSG path, and the aura must be gone. Fails pre-fix (aura stays).
